description: This file provides utility functions for executing and managing child processes, including cross-platform command resolution, safe argument escaping, and process spawning with timeout and output handling.

methods.name: isWindowsBatchCommand
methods.description: Checks if a given command is a Windows batch script (.cmd or .bat).

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes a command-line argument for safe inclusion in cmd.exe commands.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Builds a command line string for cmd.exe with proper escaping.

methods.name: resolveNpmArgvForWindows
methods.description: Resolves npm or npx commands to their node CLI scripts on Windows to avoid spawn errors.

methods.name: resolveCommand
methods.description: Resolves a command for Windows, handling special cases like pnpm and yarn.

methods.name: resolveChildProcessInvocation
methods.description: Prepares the command and arguments for spawning a child process, considering platform-specific quirks.

methods.name: shouldSpawnWithShell
methods.description: Determines if a command should be spawned with a shell (always false here for security).

methods.name: runExec
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously with optional verbose logging.

methods.name: resolveProcessExitCode
methods.description: Determines the process exit code based on various signals and conditions.

methods.name: resolveCommandEnv
methods.description: Resolves and merges environment variables for command execution, with special handling for npm.

methods.name: runCommandWithTimeout
methods.description: Runs a command with a specified timeout, capturing output and handling process termination.
